summary: Proposal updated to include the user's split of skill-authoring rules from root AGENTS.md into skills/AGENTS.md as an explicit audit target. Current measurements: root AGENTS.md 2,861 chars; skills/AGENTS.md 4,284 chars with line-length lint warnings. Topic map regenerated after reindex; validation passed with candidate-only map warnings.

Requirements approved and corrected to treat AGENTS.md files as scoped instruction files, not DOX framework artifacts. Requirements cover inventory/budgets, compact skill kernels, AGENTS.md hierarchy locality, state-aware compaction/resume, active tool/schema control, and behavior-preserving migration/validation.

Design updated to reflect user correction that the DOX framework has already been removed. Requirements/design now target scoped AGENTS.md instruction files rather than DOX framework/index mechanics. The AGENTS.md locality decision remains: root project-wide instructions, skills/AGENTS.md skill-specific instructions, size/lint/dedup budgets. Validation passed with existing candidate-only map warnings.

Please review and approve the context-bloat-audit plan before implementation. Plan has seven phases: P0 inventory/budgets; P1 implement kernel; P2 plan/proposal kernels; P3 scoped AGENTS.md cleanup; P4 resume primer; P5 tool/schema audit; P6 final regression/fold-in/ADR.

P0 implementation complete: added non-interactive context inventory script, tests, package check integration, and plan reference documentation. Inventory reports root/child AGENTS.md, active skill descriptions, high-use skill bodies, references, topic resume sources, optional aggregate session compaction metrics, and best-effort tool/schema estimate. Validation receipts passed for unit tests, real checkout inventory, check:scripts, and topic validation.

P1 implementation complete: compacted skills/implement/SKILL.md from 28,206 chars to 6,599 chars, created one-level references and rule relocation ledger, added dry-run evidence, and passed inventory, skill-language, check:scripts, and topic validation. Implement kernel is under the 8k budget with references all under budget.

P2 implementation complete: compacted skills/plan/SKILL.md to 6,585 chars and skills/proposal/SKILL.md to 7,335 chars, both under 10k budgets. Added one-level references and relocation ledgers for plan/proposal. Dry-run evidence confirms wrapper sequences, validation/auditor gates, requirements/design gates, fact/private safety, ADR handling, and fallback/serial gates remain discoverable.

P3 implementation complete: compacted and reformatted root AGENTS.md and skills/AGENTS.md as scoped instruction files. Root is project-wide only (2,643 chars, -218); skills/AGENTS.md is skills-only authoring guidance (3,949 chars, -335). Both are under budgets, Prettier-clean, have no >100 char lines, and no DOX wording was introduced.

P4 implementation complete and repaired after auditor feedback: added budgeted `resume-primer` state CLI output with read-only checks, max-char enforcement, truncation/omitted-section metadata, critical rules, next action, working set, validation refs, context-pack/journal pointers, and no raw private/transcript content. Extension compaction now includes safe resume-primer output or a bounded unavailable marker even if the CLI exits non-zero. Current state advances to P5/P5.T1 after P4 completion.

P5 implementation complete with auditor PASS: context inventory reports phase-scoped Cartographer tool/schema estimates and per-tool details; repeated low-risk schema description boilerplate was shortened; guardrail review confirms wrapper tools remain visible. Active-tool profiles/deferred discovery are deferred to follow-up design/ADR because measured overhead is dominated by full schemas and tool-loading changes could hide guardrails.
